name: multiple_choice: The distribution of OWL Standardized Test scores is normal…

request.questionText: The distribution of OWL Standardized Test scores is normal with a mean of 600 points and a standard deviation of 100 points. Students who cherish the ambition to join the Auror Office must earn a test score greater than 777. The proportion of test-takers who exceed this threshold is closest to which of the following?
